summary: Independent review of the deck Claude Code made from one prompt on its second run (the first run delivered ghost slides): 12 sourced slides with a clear title chain, dense on two slides, a plain cover, and specific numbers whose sources the user should confirm.

findings.issue: Numbers of the steps that are not highlighted had 2.46:1 contrast (SC-CONTRAST-001)
findings.fix: shared: numbered process steps keep their large numbers at 3:1 while they recede

findings.issue: The cover has no visual: the cover choice step was skipped
findings.fix: Run `slidecraft covers` and choose; the rule is in AGENTS.md
Move detail to the notes or split the slide

findings.issue: Specific figures (token sizes, context windows, a 44% survey figure, OWASP ranking) are attributed to vendor pages and reports the reviewer cannot verify
findings.fix: Check each figure against its source before external use

findings.issue: Key-point headings sit about 1 px apart in PowerPoint and the browser
